versions.notes:
- 작업 분야의 아이콘·글자를 가운데 맞추고 카드 여백과 글자 위계를 조정했습니다.
- 우편 숫자 대신 새 편지가 있을 때만 반짝임 표시를 보여줍니다.
- 맑음·흐림·비·눈의 홈 배경 연출과 효과 켜기/끄기, 브라우저별 설정 저장을 추가했습니다. 현실 날씨 조회는 아직 제공하지 않습니다.
- 날씨 그림 4종을 추가하고 동작 줄이기 설정을 반영했습니다.

- 사계절 화면 바탕과 홈 배경, 지도·실내·초대 장면 11개를 여백이 넓은 단순한 그림으로 교체했습니다.
- 간판 글자를 나무판 영역에 고정하고 홈에 현재 계절 문구를 표시합니다.
- 지면 편집을 44px 아이콘 버튼으로 바꾸고 빈 상태를 중앙 정렬했습니다.
- 보조 버튼과 선택기에 축소 종이 장식을 반복하던 표현을 정리했습니다.

- 공방 작업의 세부 탭을 통합하고 생산 설정·우선순위·적용을 한 화면에 배치했습니다.
- 홈의 생산물 보고 카드와 이야기 삽화를 복원했습니다.
- 탐사 지도, 공방 실내, 초대 장면, 이야기 삽화, 편지지 그림을 추가했습니다.
- 기존 종이 에셋을 보조 버튼·선택기에 활용하고 메뉴 선택 표시를 통일했습니다.
- Add illustrated Home, Work, Explore, Residents and Invite navigation icons, with the original accessible labels and fallback icons.

- Fit story text to the dialogue area, clarify resident registration and production waiting states, show item pictures in reports and the starter kit, open activity letters directly, and use game-style page selectors.

- Survey and patrol around the workshop with one recruited resident. Activities use workshop time, detach facility assignments, can be cancelled, and save one fixed result letter on completion. No resource rewards or model calls. Schema 11 worlds cannot be opened by older packages.

- Inbox and archive for a fixed workshop welcome letter, with unread count and persistent read/archive state. No rewards, expiry or automatic model calls. Letters are included in world backups. Schema 10 worlds cannot be opened by older packages. Resident-generated letters remain in development.

- Configure world and pair writing preferences for newly generated stories. Existing stories and memory visibility remain unchanged. Generation records store applied guideline revisions. Schema 9 worlds cannot be opened by older packages.

- Manage memories and view a pair’s shared memories. Corrections preserve the original and its knowledge scope; memories can be disabled and restored. New memory writes refuse at capacity instead of silently discarding records. Previously discarded memories cannot be recovered.

- Display settings now control automatic story advance by default with a 2–10 second interval. Questions, backlog, leaving the story and backgrounding pause it. Finishing and saving a story stays explicit. Preferences are local to this browser.

- Edit the rectangular movement area directly over the home background by dragging its four edges. Save, cancel and reset are available on Home. Home residents move horizontally and vertically within this range. Ground is included in world backups. Schema 8 worlds cannot be opened by older packages. Obstacles, polygon editing and full interaction behavior remain in development.

- Resident profiles show a portrait and give direct access to their relationships.
- Align facility and stock actions evenly and keep the work status compact.
- Work status provides direct access to protected stock and the sales storeroom.
- Facility details always open the selected facility instead of a previously viewed storage tab.
- Home opens the active facility directly when showing an active job; unread reports still open the report.
- Removed the duplicate exchange shortcut from the invite tab and the in-game fullscreen button. Delivery list responses are ignored after changing worlds or starting a newer request. Mobile game layout and actual Android installation remain under development.

- Exploration episodes can be selected directly to inspect their status and requirements; today’s delivery board shows three selectable requests and the chosen request’s usable and protected stock.
- When no new report is waiting, Home shows one active production task and its remaining time; tapping it opens the work report. This is an estimated countdown.
- Home resident name labels are hidden and existing resident pictures turn when moving. Dialogue and narration have a stable panel height; longer text is shown in consecutive parts. Emotion position uses the same setting in the picture preview and story. Actual Android layout, long text at enlarged sizes and the wider production journey remain unverified.

- Resident, storage, invite and story-history lists allow direct group selection; profile history uses the same control. Small ordering buttons have larger touch targets and keyboard focus is visible.
- Work screens offer direct product selection, draft application, recommendations and facility upgrades; queue and priority selection no longer require paging. Home residents move slightly within their spots.
- Read episodes appear in history immediately. The reader has a compact dialogue panel, placement-aware emotion marks and direct answers for shorter questions.
- Completed stories no longer silently discard older arcs at 50. The 1,000-arc per-pair limit and 1,000-scene backup limit remain; older discarded progress is not recovered. Older package versions cannot load worlds with more than 50 completed arcs.
- Android installation and device layout remain unverified; at 320×640 the work screen can require vertical scrolling. Home movement is not a walking animation.

- World selection keeps the new-world form closed when a world already exists and pages existing worlds. Tap a resident on Home to open their profile; profiles separate workshop settings, original settings and paged history, and retain an unfinished edit across refreshes. Resident registration and lists use smaller steps and pages; workshop controls, queues and ordering are separated into smaller views. Facilities, stock protection, storage and settings are separated into smaller views; inventory and protection editing use pages. Exploration groups preparation, journey and history, and invitation lists use pages. Full mobile layout and installation verification remain incomplete.
- Home includes the latest layout and visual improvements. Other screens and the actual mobile layout have not yet been verified.

- The workshop now has its own art: a picture for every item and facility, the season's backdrop and workshop scene, emotion marks in stories, the wooden title sign, and paper, wood and button panels. A picture that cannot load falls back to the drawn look.
- 설정 → 표시 → 계절: follow today's date or pick spring, summer, autumn or winter. Only the current season's pictures are loaded; the season changes the look only.
- Story emotions are now joy, affection, curiosity, fluster, inspiration and annoyance; scenes written earlier keep showing with the nearest mark.

- Fixed: a late heartbeat or read could put an older revision of the world back on screen, and an answer for a world you had left could replace the one you opened. Updates now apply only to the same world and never go backwards; opening a world drops answers from an earlier navigation.
- Fixed: once the 72-hour absence budget was used, background reads on later days kept auto-selling. The workshop now stays frozen until you return; a return or a command still re-evaluates at once.

- 탐사 → 이야기 탐험: each pair goes through arcs of three episodes. Episode 1 needs one resident, 2 and 3 need both; the next opens after the previous is read. Expeditions take 30–90 minutes of workshop time (the 72-hour rule applies), use up to two preparations and can be cancelled with everything returned.
- Reading a scene for the first time asks your language model to write it from the stored plan and only the memories its residents share. A refused or failed answer stores nothing; retry the same plan at no cost.
- The reader: emotion marks, backlog, auto, and one answer to a resident's question (it raises that resident's trust and only they remember it). Reading records what the residents learned and changes the pair a little.
- Backups now carry the written scenes.

- More to make: 15 materials (pinecones, acorns, pumpkins, cotton, tea leaves, beeswax, feathers, four-leaf clovers…), 8 processed goods and 11 finished goods, with longer chains such as cotton → thread → scarf or tea → herb tea → gift box. More delivery requests use them.
- A resident's field and talent are now decided when they are registered, read from their own character or persona text, and shown before you confirm; they no longer change afterwards. Each talent speeds up one recipe of that field or saves one input.
- Existing residents keep a field you already chose and get a matching talent; others get both from their stored source text.
